criteria.reason: class-event-rsvp-ajax.php init() hooks both wp_ajax_event_rsvp_submit and wp_ajax_nopriv_event_rsvp_submit to submit().

event-rsvp.php event_rsvp_register_block() builds a config with ajaxUrl => admin_url('admin-ajax.php') and nonce => wp_create_nonce('event_rsvp_submit'), then adds it to every view_script_handle with wp_add_inline_script(..., 'before').
Event_RSVP_Ajax::submit() calls check_ajax_referer('event_rsvp_submit', 'nonce'), which matches the action used to create the nonce and the 'nonce' field that view.js appends.

submit() runs sanitize_text_field on name, sanitize_email plus is_email on email, and absint on guests with a 1–EVENT_RSVP_MAX_GUESTS (5) range check, and returns errors with wp_send_json_error() (400/409/500).

Event_RSVP_DB::install() is the register_activation_hook callback; it requires wp-admin/includes/upgrade.php, uses $wpdb->get_charset_collate(), puts two spaces in 'PRIMARY KEY  (id)' and calls dbDelta().
Event_RSVP_DB::insert() calls $wpdb->insert() with the formats array('%d','%s','%s','%d','%s'), and table() builds the name with $wpdb->prefix.
Event_RSVP_List_Table extends WP_List_Table and defines prepare_items, get_columns, get_sortable_columns, column_cb, get_bulk_actions (delete) and column renderers.

process_actions() calls check_admin_referer(self::BULK_NONCE, self::BULK_FIELD), which matches wp_nonce_field in render_page, checks current_user_can('manage_options'), and Event_RSVP_DB::delete() runs $wpdb->prepare with %d placeholders.

export_csv() is hooked on admin_post_event_rsvp_export; it checks capability, calls check_admin_referer with its own export nonce, sends nocache_headers plus Content-Type and Content-Disposition headers, streams fputcsv output and exits.

Event_RSVP_Bindings::register() runs on init and calls register_block_bindings_source('event-rsvp/count', [label, get_value_callback, uses_context => ['postId']]); get_value reads $block_instance->context['postId'].
view.js onSubmit() posts FormData via window.fetch with action and nonce, then shows the success message or per-field and general error messages.
render.php escapes output with esc_attr, esc_html and wp_kses on the heading, and uses get_block_wrapper_attributes; the list table columns use esc_html, esc_url and esc_attr throughout.

Every API used (register_block_bindings_source with uses_context, view_script_handles, is_post_type_viewable, wp_unique_id, antispambot, add_screen_option, etc.) exists in WordPress; none are invented.
